Subject: Mutual action plan acceptance, final go/no-go and start-date alignment

Neha / Karthik,

Thanks again for the MAP workshop yesterday — the team found the performance profiles and the rollout plan helpful. We've reviewed the most recent MAP and the attached SOW (TenantCloud-MAP-v3.pdf). We think the plan is ready from our side with two small asks:

- Confirm legal/contract next steps and an estimated timeline for sign-off through procurement.
- Confirm a firm start date for the pilot (we're targeting week of Oct 10).

If you can confirm those two items, we'll queue the purchase order on our side. I've cc'd procurement and Sofia from Legal for any redlines.

Attachments: TenantCloud-MAP-v3.pdf (MAP), draft SOW note.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Platform Engineering | TenantCloud
liam.oconnor@tenantcloud.com

Hi Liam — thanks, glad the MAP session helped.

Quick answers:
1) Legal redlines: ask Sofia to send any specific redline bullets; we'll review and aim to resolve routine commercial items within 48 hours. Monica (CS lead) will own SOW finalization once commercial/legal are cleared.
2) Start date: Oct 10 is workable on our side; we'll treat that as tentative until DocuSign is complete and PO is in.

Proposed next steps:
- Sofia/legal to return redline PDF or DocuSign comments by EOD Fri (9/24).
- Redwood legal + Karthik to triage redlines 9/24–9/25.
- Final go/no-go signoff call: Mon 9/27, 11:00 AM PT (30 min). Can you confirm availability?

I've attached the current pricing sheet for quick reference.

Thanks — I'll loop in Monica on SOW tasks separately.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Neha — thanks. A couple of small items from Legal:

- We'd like to propose a one-sentence tweak to the "Data Retention" clause to clarify deletion timing (we'll mark it in the PDF).
- Liability cap: TenantCloud prefers a cap at 2x fees for the pilot phase. If Redwood can confirm that for the pilot SOW, procurement can move quickly.

Procurement note: PO team expects finalized SOW + signed contract + pricing sheet to approve PO by 10/05 if redlines are minimal.

I've started a DocuSign envelope for the latest SOW so reviewers can add comments inline: https://www.docusign.com/link/placeholder-TNT-045.

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: TenantCloud redlines / go-no-go recommendation

Team — quick internal note before we reply to TenantCloud: 

- Recommendation: Accept the proposed data-retention sentence tweak (non-substantive operational clarification).
- Liability cap: for a short pilot we can accept a 2x-fees cap, but request an explicit carve for gross negligence / willful misconduct (standard).
- Commercial impact: accepting the 2x cap for the pilot is low risk and materially increases chance of PO on time (target 10/05).

Proposed commercial concession (optional): offer a 30-day migration support credit in the SOW (one-time credit) to offset the tighter liability. This is purely discretionary but could move procurement faster.

If no objections I recommend we (1) confirm redline acceptance to Sofia, (2) ask DocuSign thread to be used for final signatures, (3) schedule the go/no-go call for Mon 9/27 11:00 AM PT.

Karthik
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@tenantcloud.com>, Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@tenantcloud.com>, procurement@tenantcloud.com
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan acceptance, final go/no-go and start-date alignment

Liam / Sofia / procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Outline below is what we can commit to: 

1) Redlines: Redwood accepts the requested data-retention language as-is and accepts the 2x-fees liability cap limited to the pilot scope, with the standard carve for gross negligence / willful misconduct. Legal teams: please confirm via the DocuSign comments so Monica can lock the SOW.

2) DocuSign & signatures: We'll use the DocuSign envelope Sofia created for the final contract and SOW. Please add any inline comments by EOD Fri 9/24; Redwood legal will triage immediately and circulate the final envelope for signatures.

3) Final go/no-go: Proposed call Mon 9/27, 11:00 AM PT. Objectives: confirm signed contract + PO timing and lock the start date. Please confirm attendees (we expect Liam + Sofia + TenantCloud PO, Neha + Karthik + Monica + one engineering lead).

4) Start date: Tentative start date set to Oct 10, confirmed once DocuSign completes and PO is issued. Monica will own day-zero readiness and onboarding plan.

Attachments: SOW-TenantCloud-v1.docx (Monica will take edits from DocuSign), TenantCloud-MAP-v3.pdf.

Next steps (brief):
- TenantCloud: confirm availability for 9/27 11:00 AM PT and PO approver name.
- TenantCloud Legal: finalize DocuSign comments (if any).
- Redwood: finalize pricing and prepare kickoff checklist (Monica).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
